row.name: cmi5_sessions_ids_check
row.value: char_length(au_id) between 1 and 500 and char_length(activity_id) between 1 and 2000

row.name: cmi5_sessions_ending_check
row.value:
(ended_at is null) = (ending is null)
        and (ending is null or ending in ('terminated', 'abandoned'))

row.name: cmi5_states_fields_check
row.value:
char_length(activity_id) between 1 and 2000 and char_length(state_id) between 1 and 500
        and char_length(content_type) between 1 and 200 and octet_length(body) <= 65536
